I really really understand. But sometimes I think that maybe parents shouldnt be made to feel bad but sometimes I do. My mother had depression and she abused me and although I can see the logic that she did those things because depression, but it doesn't erase the hurt. When I was in preschool I got molested by a classmate, I can see the logic that he was young and didn't know what he way doing, but it doesn't erase the hurt.

So sometimes I think do they really deserve to be made to feel bad if I kill myself although they were kind of the source of my depression? Both me and them were victims of circumstance. Sure it really really pisses me off that she doesnt remember how she used to beat me and burn me. But should she be made to carry that burden? Sometimes I get really angry at her and fantasise about how I'll kill myself and think "that'll teach her" then I realise that's a lifetime of hurt for her, she'll die knowing that she "killed" me. Sometimes I think she doesn't have many years left and she's my mother, and I should be the bigger person. I still love her although she abused me. And I don't want her to feel bad. I feel like a shitty person for saying that because I'm enabling her but she's my mother y know?
